display.purpose: Hero headings, oracle name, section titles. Bebas Neue compressed line-height (0.95) creates monumental density.

headline.purpose: Subsection headers, feature headings. Scaled-down display authority.

title.purpose: Oracle statistics, numerical verdicts, credential counts.

body.purpose: Table cells, terminal output, body copy. Max line length 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Micro-labels, stat descriptors, column headers. All-caps + 0.14-0.18em tracking.

motion.name: state-transition

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Card border brightening and translateY(-2px) lift.

motion.name: confidence-bar
motion.purpose: Confidence bar scaleX() entrance. Ease-out expo, no layout thrash.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.note: Input font-size bumped to 16px at this breakpoint to prevent iOS Safari auto-zoom.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Oracle Amber background, Ink text, zero radius. Stamp-ready.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; background: #E8A020; color: #0C0C0A; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 14px 32px; min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 0; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8A020; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent, rule-hi border. Becomes Archive Cream on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; background: transparent; color: #9A978F; padding: 11px 18px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(240,237,230,0.14); border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #9A978F; color: #F0EDE6; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8A020; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field. Ink Surface background, gold focus border. Machine-native.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #111110; border: 1px solid rgba(240,237,230,0.14); color: #F0EDE6; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; padding: 12px 16px; outline: none; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #E8A020; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4A4844; }

components.name: Surface Card

components.css: .ds-surface { background: #111110; border: 1px solid rgba(240,237,230,0.07); padding: 20px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; border-radius: 0; } .ds-surface:hover { border-color: rgba(240,237,230,0.14); }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Tabbed navigation. Oracle Amber underline for active state, no background fill.

narrative.overview:
Prooflink is the API endpoint that hiring AI agents hit at 2am. No human in the loop. The interface reads clean because machines read it first — and humans who trust machines can read it too. Every design decision serves one directive: make a trust primitive legible at machine speed and human glance simultaneously.

The system is built from institutional restraint and metrological precision. Surfaces are dark not because tools are dark, but because this is infrastructure: the SRE console, the certificate authority interface, the verification terminal. Nothing decorative survives this scene.

Typography is the primary carrier of weight. Bebas Neue for names and verdicts — compressed, permanent, unapologetic. Geist Mono for evidence and data — calibrated, machine-native, honest. No warmth is performed. Trust is earned through precision.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp corners everywhere. Zero border-radius signals precision, not softness.
Tonal depth via background steps (ink → ink-surface → ink-raised), never shadows.
Oracle Amber as the sole accent — active states, verdicts, CTAs. Rarity is the point.
Border opacity ramp (7% → 14%) as the only elevation signal at rest.
Monospace-first: the credential system speaks in machine-readable formats.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Oracle Amber is used on at most 10-15% of any given screen surface. Its scarcity is what makes it the oracle's voice.

rules.name: The Warm Void Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward the amber hue (chroma 0.003–0.008). No pure black. No pure white.

rules.name: The Mono Default Rule
rules.body: When in doubt, use Geist Mono. The system speaks in machine-readable formats. Geist sans is the exception.

rules.name: The Scale Discipline Rule
rules.body: Never use font sizes below 9px for any text that carries meaning. Critical content floors at 11px.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only motion elevation is translateY(-2px) on skill card hover. No box-shadow additions.

rules.name: The Tonal Stacking Rule
rules.body: Never use a darker background for a higher surface. Elevation always moves from ink (darkest) to ink-raised (lightest).

dos: Do use Oracle Amber for CTAs, active states, and verification signals only. Rarity is the mechanism of trust.
Do use zero border-radius on all rectangular UI elements. Curved corners belong in a different product category.
Do use Bebas Neue for verdicts and names; Geist Mono for evidence and data.
Do layer depth through background tonal steps: ink → ink-surface → ink-raised. Never shadows.
Do set font-size: 16px minimum on form inputs in mobile breakpoints to prevent iOS Safari auto-zoom.
Do use transform: scaleX() (not width) for progress bar animations to avoid layout thrash.
Do keep body line-length at 65-75ch maximum.
Do write copy in the oracle's voice: terse, infrastructure-confident, no hype.
donts: Don't use generic crypto aesthetics: neon-on-black, laser grids, coin-ticker iconography, meme vibes.
Don't use SaaS cream: purple gradients, Stripe-clone hero metrics, Tailwind defaults, floating orbs.
Don't use hacker terminal aesthetics: green-on-black, ASCII art as decoration, monospace as personality.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Emphasis via weight or size only.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as a colored accent).
Don't add box shadows. The system has no shadow vocabulary.
Don't use the hero-metric template: big number, small label, gradient accent.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. transform and opacity only.
Don't use Dispute Red for challenge or dispute actions. Oracle Amber for legitimate user actions; red for genuine system errors only.
